craft_notes: Sthāyin: climb-and-climber-are-knowing. Sanskrit-first: āroha (CLIMB — imperative, kept); jñāna-pada (KNOWING'S-SEAT — kept; ascent-method standard-marked per UNC). Rows: 7 (imperative opens — direct command), 1 (‘knowing’ closes — climber IS knowing last). Close: ‘the climber is knowing’. Rupture: em-dash (command, then identity). Rejected: ‘one-who-climbs’ — killed: climber climbs; ‘summit’ — killed: seat (pada) kept. Read aloud: CLIMB to KNOW-ing's-SEAT — … AND the CLIMB-er IS-know-ING.

reads_against.argmap: How is freedom won back? → Return by recognition, not effort: climb, burn, own, hold fast.
c1_essence: Return climbs, burns, owns, holds fast — freedom alive.
